plain.li: [trigger:death] I spent the morning digging a grave. {OTHER_nameDef} spent it eating breakfast in bed. Explain that to me.
{OTHER_nameDef} counts the guards through the bars. I've watched {OTHER_objective} do it. That's not a prisoner, that's a scout waiting for a door.
[night] I lie awake listening for the cell door. One bad latch, and {OTHER_nameDef} is standing over somebody's bed.

warm.li: [grieving] I'm not a cruel person. I'm just tired of walking past {OTHER_nameDef} on my way to the graves.
There are people here I'd die for. I won't gamble them on {OTHER_nameDef} having a change of heart.

blunt.li: [trigger:raid] {OTHER_nameDef} shot at me yesterday. Today I'm supposed to carry {OTHER_objective} soup. No.
[trait:Bloodlust] I've already picked the spot. Downwind of the kitchen. I'm not unreasonable.
The cell isn't an inn. Somebody check {OTHER_nameDef} out.

cheerful.li: Good news, everyone: we're about to have a spare bed in the prison! Well, once somebody deals with {OTHER_nameDef}!
[trigger:raid] We won! Mostly! Let's tidy up the last little bit of the raid! The bit in the cell!

gloomy.li: [trigger:death] There's an empty chair at supper now. Meanwhile somebody carries a full bowl to {OTHER_nameDef}. Every night.
I dream about {OTHER_nameDef} getting out. It ends the same way every time, and I'm the one who doesn't wake up.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] I'd be happy to do it. Not eager. Happy. I'm told the difference matters.
[trigger:raid] {OTHER_nameDef}'s friends will come back for {OTHER_objective}. A prisoner is a reason to raid us. Remove the reason.

plain.li: [trigger:death] I went and told the grave. Felt stupid. Felt better.

warm.li: [grieving] It doesn't bring anyone back, I know. I just needed to stop seeing that face every day.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] Shame it was quick. Still. It's done.

cheerful.li: Spare cell! Does anyone want a very quiet room? No? Just me? Okay!

gloomy.li: [promised] You said it would be done, and it's done. I thought I'd sleep. I'm still awake, but at least I know where {OTHER_nameDef} is.

cold.li: One less mouth and a warden with free hours. I've already reassigned them in my head.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] I'll stand guard outside {OTHER_nameDef}'s cell myself, then. All night. With my finger on the trigger.

warm.li: [trusting] You've been right before. I hope this is one of those times, because I really don't think it is.

blunt.li: [bitter] So the raider gets a say and the dead don't. Got it.

gloomy.li: [grieving] I'll take the long way to the graves from now on. The short way goes past the cell.

cold.li: Noted. When {OTHER_nameDef} escapes, I'd like the record to show who argued for what.

plain.li: [night] {OTHER_nameDef} was humming in the cell tonight. Humming. I thought the council should know.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] I sharpen my knife in front of the cell now. {OTHER_nameDef} watches me do it. We're getting to know each other.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has eaten well this week. Better than some of us. I've kept a list.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked me what season it was. I told {OTHER_objective}. {OTHER_nameDef} just nodded and went back to staring at the wall.
[repeat] I asked about {OTHER_nameDef} before. Nothing in that cell has changed, except how thin {OTHER_pronoun} looks.
[night] You can hear {OTHER_nameDef} through the wall at night, talking to someone who isn't there. Let {OTHER_objective} go home to whoever it is.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has a home somewhere with a door that doesn't lock from the outside. Let's point {OTHER_objective} toward it.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} drew me a picture through the bars. It was a house. Can't we let {OTHER_objective} go and find it?
[grieving] I've buried enough people this year. I'd like to send one home instead.

blunt.li: We're not running a zoo. Open the door or recruit {OTHER_nameDef}. I don't care which.
[afterraid] Yes, I know what just happened. {OTHER_nameDef} wasn't in that raid. {OTHER_nameDef} was in a cell. Let {OTHER_objective} go.

cheerful.li: Picture it: {OTHER_nameDef} walks home, tells everyone we were lovely, and they raid somebody else! Everyone wins! Except somebody else!
I taught {OTHER_nameDef} a pebble game through the bars and said the winner goes free! I'd really like to let {OTHER_objective} win!

gloomy.li: [old] I was somebody's prisoner once, a long time ago. You never forget the sound of the lock.
Every day in there, {OTHER_nameDef} gets a little quieter. One day there won't be anything left to let go.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} costs a warden, a bed and a meal a day, and returns nothing. Release is the cheap option. For once it's also the kind one.
A prisoner who wastes away in our cell is a grievance their people will remember. A released one is a debt.

plain.li: The cell's empty and nobody had to dig anything. Good day.

warm.li: [trait:Kind] I gave {OTHER_nameDef} my spare coat on the way out of that cell. It looked better on {OTHER_objective} anyway.

blunt.li: Door's open. Nobody died. Write that down, it doesn't happen often around here.

cheerful.li: [promised] You promised and you DID it! I'm hugging everyone! Brace yourselves!

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s people will probably shoot at us again someday. I'll still be glad we did this.

cold.li: No longer our prisoner, and still breathing. That's the version of this that pays.

plain.li: [promised] I told {OTHER_nameDef} it would be soon. I'm going to have to stop saying soon.

warm.li: [night] I sat by the cell tonight so {OTHER_nameDef} wouldn't be alone. That's all I'm allowed to do, apparently.

blunt.li: [bitter] This council could find a key if it wanted to. It doesn't want to.

cheerful.li: Okay! New plan! I visit {OTHER_nameDef} every single day until somebody gets embarrassed and opens the door!

gloomy.li: We'll keep {OTHER_nameDef} in that box until the box is all that's left of {OTHER_objective}.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} asked after the council today. I said you were thinking it over. Are you?

warm.li: [trusting] I know you'll do right by {OTHER_nameDef}. I'm only bringing it up because the cell is so cold.

gloomy.li: [winter] The cell gets colder every week. {OTHER_nameDef} has started sleeping sitting up.

plain.li: [afterraid] Everyone's off in a corner cleaning the same weapon over and over. Put us all in one room before it gets strange.
[rain] It's raining anyway, and nobody can work the fields. Let's waste the day properly. Together.
Nobody's talked about anything but food and raiders in weeks. I'd like one evening about anything else.

warm.li: [skill:Social] I've noticed who's been eating alone lately. A party gets them to the table without anybody making a fuss.
[grieving] We should get together. Not to forget. Just so nobody has to remember alone.

blunt.li: Everyone's been glaring at each other for a week. Either we have a party or we have a duel. Your call.
[trait:Abrasive] I don't even like most of you. I'd still like to see you drunk. It helps.
[poor] We're broke, not dead. Fire's free. Noise is free. Party.

cheerful.li: I've been practicing a dance! It's mostly elbows! I need witnesses!
[winter] Snow outside, fire inside, everybody squashed together telling terrible stories! Please!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] Nobody here has smiled in days, me included. I'd like to find out whether we still can.
[night] The nights here are so quiet you start listening for things. I'd like one night loud enough to drown them out.

cold.li: Half the colony has snapped at me this week. A party costs less than a breakdown, and much less than a funeral.
[trait:Psychopath] People say things at a party they'd never say sober. I'd like to hear those things.

plain.li: [morning] Somebody's asleep under the table and nobody's moving them. That's how you know it was a good party.

warm.li: I saw people talking tonight who haven't said a word to each other all season. That's worth a sore head.

blunt.li: Fine. It was fun. Don't tell anyone I danced.

cheerful.li: [promised] You promised a party and it was the BEST party! I danced with a chair! The chair led!

gloomy.li: Tomorrow it's raiders and rice again. Tonight it wasn't. I'm holding on to that.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] I learned a great deal tonight. Mostly about who can't hold a drink.

plain.li: I'd saved my good shirt for it. I'll save it for the next funeral instead. There's always a next funeral.

warm.li: Never mind. I'll go round and sit with people one at a time. Slower, but it's something.

blunt.li: [bitter] The council doesn't do fun. The council does lists.

cheerful.li: No party? Fine! I'll just be extremely festive at work! Nobody can stop me! Somebody may try!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] It's fine. I'd only have stood in a corner. Now I don't have to.

plain.li: [evening] Another evening of everyone eating fast and going to bed. About that party...

cheerful.li: I've been decorating! A little! Nobody's noticed! A party would make them notice!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] The mood around here is getting heavy enough to sit on. Mentioning the party again.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s boots are still by the door. Nobody wants to move them. I'd rather {OTHER_nameDef} came back and moved them.
[night] I keep thinking I hear {OTHER_nameDef} coming in late from the fields. Then I remember where {OTHER_pronoun} is.
[repeat] Every trader who passes, I ask about {SUBJECT}. Now I'm asking you. Again.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} used to save me the warm spot by the fire. I've been keeping it warm. Please let me give it back.
[child] {OTHER_nameDef} promised to come back. Grown-ups keep their promises, don't they? Can we help?

blunt.li: Somewhere out there, someone from {SUBJECT} is wearing {OTHER_nameDef}'s coat. I'd like it back. With {OTHER_nameDef} in it.
[afterraid] They took {OTHER_nameDef} out of our own yard. I'm not waiting for them to come back for seconds.
[skill:Shooting] I can hit a squirrel from across the valley. Get me close to {SUBJECT} and see what else I can hit.

cheerful.li: When {OTHER_nameDef} gets home, I'm cooking a feast! I've planned every dish! We just need the rescuing part!
[highmood] I just know {OTHER_nameDef} is fine! Probably giving {SUBJECT} a terrible time! Let's go collect {OTHER_objective}!

gloomy.li: [grieving] I've buried enough people. {OTHER_nameDef} is still alive somewhere. That makes this the one I can still do something about.
[winter] Do they give {OTHER_nameDef} a blanket over there? I lie awake wondering. I'd like to stop wondering.

cold.li: Every day with {SUBJECT}, {OTHER_nameDef} gets a little less useful to us. Retrieve {OTHER_objective} while it's still worth the trip.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't miss people. I do notice when things are taken from me. {OTHER_nameDef} was taken from me.

plain.li: [night] I checked on {OTHER_nameDef} three times last night. There every time.

warm.li: [promised] You said we'd bring {OTHER_nameDef} home, and you did. I'll never doubt this council again. Well. Not this season.

blunt.li: Tell {SUBJECT} to try that again. Go on. Tell them.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is home! I've followed {OTHER_objective} around all day! {OTHER_nameDef} says it's too much! It's not enough!

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} doesn't talk about what happened over there, and I don't ask. {OTHER_nameDef} is here. That's the part that matters.

cold.li: Recovered, mostly intact. Now let's discuss what {SUBJECT} owes us.

plain.li: [promised] I told {OTHER_nameDef} we'd come. Wherever {OTHER_nameDef} is now, I hope {OTHER_pronoun} stopped waiting.

warm.li: I'll keep {OTHER_nameDef}'s things in a box under my bed. If {OTHER_nameDef} ever finds a way home alone, nothing will be missing.

blunt.li: [bitter] {OTHER_nameDef} would have come for any one of you. Remember that the next time you need someone.

gloomy.li: [night] I keep picturing {OTHER_nameDef} watching the horizon for us. And we just never come.

cold.li: So {OTHER_nameDef} is a loss. I'll stop setting aside {OTHER_possessive} share of the food.

plain.li: [snow] It's snowing. {OTHER_nameDef} hates the cold. I hope {SUBJECT} gave {OTHER_objective} a coat, at least.

warm.li: [trusting] I know a rescue takes planning. I'd just like to hear that the plan exists.

blunt.li: [bitter] Still waiting on {OTHER_nameDef}. Or has the council forgotten {OTHER_objective} too?

plain.li: [skill:Shooting] All I shoot at lately is raiders. They're big, they're slow and they shoot back. A deer is honest work.
[poor] The stores are thin and there's a herd grazing past the fields. I don't see the problem.
[fog] Fog's low, wind's right. Anything out there won't see me until it's dinner.

warm.li: The cooks have been making the same meal out of the same sack for a week. Let me bring them something to work with.
[old] My eyes are still good at a distance, even if they're useless for reading. Let me use them while they last.

blunt.li: I've cleaned this weapon so often it's cleaner than the kitchen. Let me get it dirty.
[trait:Bloodlust] No raids, no fights, nothing. Something has to bleed, and I'd rather it had antlers.
[winter] The muffalo are fat and slow and walking past our walls like they own the place. They don't.

cheerful.li: I'll bring back the biggest thing I can carry! Or drag! Or roll! I'm flexible!
[spring] Everything out there is fat and silly with spring! I'd like to go and say hello! Loudly!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] I'd like to sit still in the cold for half a day waiting for something to die. It's the closest thing I have to a hobby.
Everything out there dies of something. Hunger, a cougar, the winter. Mine's quicker than all of them.

cold.li: [skill:Shooting] A clean shot through the lungs at range. The animal barely knows. I'd like to keep my hand in.
[trait:Psychopath] I find it calming. The breathing, the waiting, the moment it stops. I'll bring the meat back, of course.

plain.li: [morning] Out before dawn, back by breakfast, meat on the table. That's a good day by anyone's measure.

warm.li: I told the cook to give the best cut to whoever's been working hardest. Not me. Probably not me.

blunt.li: [trait:Bloodlust] Better. I'm calm now. You're welcome.

cheerful.li: [promised] You marked one for me and I got it! First try! Fine, third try! It still counts!

gloomy.li: It looked right at me, just before. Like it knew. I'll eat it anyway. That's how it goes out here.

cold.li: [skill:Shooting] Through the heart, at long range. I'd like the butcher to note how little meat was spoiled.

plain.li: The deer get another week, then. Lucky deer.

blunt.li: [bitter] Fine. I'll keep my aim sharp some other way. Don't ask how.

cheerful.li: No hunt! I'll just point at the animals and whisper "bang"! It's almost as good! It is not as good!

gloomy.li: I'll watch them graze from the wall, then. They don't know how close they came.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] Unfortunate. The urge doesn't leave because the council said no. It just goes somewhere else.

plain.li: [outside] There it is again, grazing at the edge of the field. Just pointing that out.

blunt.li: My weapon's clean. My boots are on. I'm still standing here.

cheerful.li: I've named every animal out there so I'll know which one I'm hunting! I may have made this harder for myself!

plain.li: I've forgotten what the weather's like. I keep asking people. They don't know either.
[rain] I can hear the rain on the rock above us. I'd like to feel it instead.
[skill:Plants] Put me on the fields for a day. I don't care what's growing. I just want to watch it grow.

warm.li: Does anyone need something carried in from the far field? I'll take it. The long way, if nobody minds.
[child] Can I go and play outside? Just for a bit? I'll stay where you can see me.
[old] At my age you take the sun on your face whenever it's offered. I don't know how many more offers I'll get.

blunt.li: I've stared at these walls so long I know every stone by name. Don't make me introduce you.
[winter] I don't care if I lose a toe. Give me an hour out there with a shovel.

cheerful.li: I want to stand in the middle of a field and spin until I fall over! For science!
[snow] It's SNOWING and I'm in HERE! Somebody needs to fix this right now!

gloomy.li: [night] I dreamed about the sky last night. Woke up, and the ceiling was still there.
We dug into the rock to stay safe. Some days it feels like we dug our own graves and moved in early.

cold.li: People who never see daylight start making mistakes. I've noticed mine. You'll notice them soon.
[trait:Psychopath] The others are becoming very irritating to me. Fresh air would help. Help them, I mean.

plain.li: [rain] Got soaked to the skin. Best afternoon in weeks.

warm.li: [old] I sat on a rock and let the sun find me. Thank you for giving me the time.

blunt.li: Fine. I'm calm now. Nobody put me back underground for a while.

cheerful.li: I saw a bird! A real one! It ignored me completely! Wonderful!

gloomy.li: The sky was gray and the wind smelled of smoke. I stood there like an idiot and loved every minute.

cold.li: [promised] Outdoor time, as promised. My concentration has already improved.

plain.li: [indoors] I've started drawing windows on the wall. They're bad windows.

warm.li: [trusting] I'll wait. There's a lot to do. I just hope the sky's still there when I get to it.

blunt.li: [bitter] Fine. Keep me in the hole. I'll be pale and angry, and it'll be your fault.

gloomy.li: So I live under a rock now. Like something you'd find under a rock.

cold.li: Very well. When I snap, the walls will be the first suspect. The council will be the second.

plain.li: [indoors,day] Is it sunny out? Someone said it might be. I wouldn't know.

cheerful.li: Still inside! I've been describing the sky to myself from memory! It's getting less accurate!

gloomy.li: [winter] Another week indoors. My skin's the color of the walls now.

plain.li: I count the {SUBJECT} every morning. I'd like there to be more of it to count.
[morning] Woke up shaking again. Not badly. Just enough that I couldn't hold the spoon.
[repeat] Still asking about the {SUBJECT}. Still asking politely. I don't know how long politely lasts.

warm.li: I'm not proud of it. But I'm a better friend on {SUBJECT} than off it, and you've all seen me off it.
[trusting] Lock it up and hand it out fairly, I trust you with that. I just need there to be something to hand out.

blunt.li: [trait:ChemicalInterest|trait:ChemicalFascination] I'm not asking to be saved. I'm asking for a full shelf.
Don't look at me like that. Everybody here leans on something. Mine just comes with withdrawal.
[hurt] I'm in pieces already, and you want me to go without {SUBJECT} too? Pick one.

cheerful.li: Happy me, hardworking me, me on {SUBJECT}! They're all the same person! Let's keep that person around!
[highmood] See this smile? That's the {SUBJECT} talking! Let's keep it talking!

gloomy.li: [night] Nights are the worst without it. The thoughts all arrive at once, and none of them are kind.
[lowmood] I know how this story ends. I'd just like the middle to be bearable.

cold.li: I function normally on {SUBJECT}. Without it, I don't function. Decide which colonist you want.
[trait:Psychopath] Withdrawal makes me unpleasant to be around. More unpleasant. I'd rather none of you found out how much.

plain.li: The shelf's stocked. I slept through the night for the first time in a week.

warm.li: [promised] You kept your word on something most people would have lectured me about. Thank you for not lecturing.

blunt.li: Good. Now stop watching me take it.

cheerful.li: Look at my hands! Steady as a rock! A very cheerful rock!

gloomy.li: My hands have stopped shaking. The rest of me will catch up eventually. Or it won't.

cold.li: Stock is adequate. I'll ration it myself. I'm better at it than anyone you'd assign.

plain.li: [promised] I was told there'd be {SUBJECT} on the shelf. There's dust on the shelf.

blunt.li: [bitter] So I get to go cold in front of everyone. Hope you enjoy the show.

cheerful.li: Okay! Surprise detox! Very exciting! Somebody hide the knives! Joking! Mostly!

gloomy.li: [lowmood] It's coming. The shakes, the sweats, the rest of it. I'll try not to be too loud.

cold.li: Withdrawal begins shortly. I'd suggest assigning someone you don't like to supervise me.

plain.li: The shelf's still low on {SUBJECT}. I check it more often than I should.

blunt.li: I'm being patient. You can tell because nothing's broken yet.

gloomy.li: [night] Another bad night. I'm not asking for sympathy. I'm asking about the {SUBJECT}.

plain.li: I can't remember last season clearly. I'd like to remember the next one.
[trait:Teetotaler] I used to tut at anyone who touched the stuff. Now look at me. Help me get back to tutting.
[morning] I wake up already thinking about it. I'd like to wake up thinking about breakfast, like a normal person.

warm.li: Someone here looks up to me. I'd like them to be looking at something worth it.
[trusting] If anyone can keep me honest, it's this council. Lock it up, and keep the key somewhere I'd never look.

blunt.li: I'm going to be awful for a while. Hide the {SUBJECT}, hide the sharp things, and don't take it personally.
[trait:Abrasive] Yes, I'll be meaner than usual. Yes, that's possible. Do it anyway.
[hurt] I'm already in pain. Might as well get the withdrawal over with while I'm at it.

cheerful.li: I've drawn a chart of how good I'll feel once I'm clean! It goes up! Way up! The first part goes down!
[spring] Everything's starting fresh! I'd like to start fresh too! Without {SUBJECT} this time!

gloomy.li: [night] I lie awake adding up how much of my life went to {SUBJECT}. Then I want some. Then I hate myself. Every night.
[old] I've buried friends who never quit. I'd like to break the pattern before it breaks me.

cold.li: My judgment slips whenever I'm due for a dose. That's unacceptable in someone who carries a weapon.
[trait:Psychopath] I don't tolerate anything having a hold on me. Not people, and not {SUBJECT}. Cut it off.

plain.li: [morning] Woke up and didn't reach for anything. Just got up. That's the whole miracle.

warm.li: [promised] You said you'd see me through it, and you did, even the night I said those things. Sorry about those things.

blunt.li: Done. Clean. The next person who offers me {SUBJECT} gets hit.

cheerful.li: I can taste food again! It's mostly rice! I LOVE rice!

gloomy.li: The craving's gone. It left a quiet behind that I don't quite know what to do with yet.

cold.li: Clean. My hands are steady, and my decisions are my own again.

plain.li: [promised] Someone handed me {SUBJECT} again, and I took it. I'm not blaming anyone. I'm just telling you.

warm.li: [trusting] I'll try again on my own. It's harder alone, but you've all got enough on your plates.

blunt.li: [bitter] The next time someone asks why I'm still hooked, I'm sending them to the council.

gloomy.li: Still hooked. I'm starting to think it'll be the first thing anyone remembers about me. Maybe the only thing.

cold.li: The attempt failed. I'll stop asking the colony to help with things it won't help with.

plain.li: [repeat] It still has its hooks in me. I'm still trying. Keep it out of my hands.

warm.li: [trusting] Every day I don't take it is partly thanks to you lot. Please keep it that way.

gloomy.li: [night] Bad night. Didn't give in. Don't make it easy for me tomorrow.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} gets up before dawn and does stretches. Loudly. With commentary.
[night] I've started sleeping with my back to the wall so I can keep an eye on {OTHER_nameDef}. That's not rest, that's guard duty.
[winter] Stuck indoors with {OTHER_nameDef} all day, then the same room all night. All winter. I'm going to crack.

warm.li: I'm sure {OTHER_nameDef} and I could be friends someday. From separate rooms. Over a long time.
[trusting] I don't want to make trouble for {OTHER_nameDef}. I'd just like to stop waking up angry.

blunt.li: [trait:Abrasive] Either {OTHER_nameDef} moves or {OTHER_possessive} things do. Out the door. Into the mud.
{OTHER_nameDef} chews in {OTHER_possessive} sleep. Chews. On nothing. Get {OTHER_objective} out.
[repeat] I asked nicely last time. This is me asking less nicely.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I finally agree on something! We'd both love separate rooms! Teamwork!
[highmood] I'm in too good a mood to let {OTHER_nameDef} ruin it tonight! Help me keep it! Move one of us!

gloomy.li: I fall asleep to {OTHER_nameDef} sighing at me and wake up to {OTHER_nameDef} sighing at me. I'm not sure it stops in between.
[lowmood] Some nights I'd rather sleep outside with the bugs than share air with {OTHER_nameDef}.

cold.li: I've already thought through how this ends if we keep sharing a room. Separate us, and none of the endings happen.
[trait:Psychopath] {OTHER_nameDef} sleeps very deeply. I've noticed. You should move {OTHER_objective} before I notice anything else.

plain.li: [morning] I woke up and the first thing I saw wasn't {OTHER_nameDef}. Good morning, then.

warm.li: Now that we're not sharing a room, I said good morning to {OTHER_nameDef} and meant it. Mostly.

blunt.li: [trait:Abrasive] Good. If {OTHER_nameDef} sets foot in my room again, I'm charging rent.

cheerful.li: [promised] Separate rooms, just like you said! {OTHER_nameDef} and I are practically friends now! At this distance!

gloomy.li: I still can't sleep. But at least it's my own thoughts keeping me up now, not {OTHER_nameDef}.

cold.li: Separated. The odds of an incident have dropped considerably.

plain.li: [night] Still sharing with {OTHER_nameDef}. I've started sleeping with one boot on.

warm.li: I'll try harder with {OTHER_nameDef}. Someone has to, and I suppose it's me.

blunt.li: [bitter] Fine. When one of us wakes up with a black eye, don't ask me which one.

gloomy.li: So it's {OTHER_nameDef} and me until one of us dies. I've made my peace with which one I'd prefer.

cold.li: [trait:Psychopath] Understood. I'll handle the problem myself, quietly. You won't need to do anything.

plain.li: [night] {OTHER_nameDef} talked in {OTHER_possessive} sleep again. My name came up. Not kindly.

blunt.li: [repeat] Still in the same room as {OTHER_nameDef}. Still not happy about it. Still saying so.

gloomy.li: [winter] Long nights, a small room and {OTHER_nameDef}. I could manage any two of those.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] I sewed someone shut with thread meant for a shirt today. It held. It shouldn't have had to.
[winter] Flu season's coming. When it gets here, I'd like more on the shelf than a bandage and an apology.
[skill:Medicine] I count the medicine every morning. It's a short count.

warm.li: Whenever someone limps in, I look at the shelf before I look at them. I hate that.
[old] I've lost patients to bad luck and bad aim. I'd hate to lose one to an empty shelf.

blunt.li: Everybody here gets shot eventually. Stock the shelf like you believe it.
[trigger:raid] I'm out. Properly out. The next one who gets shot can bite down on a stick.
[poor] Sell something. Nobody ever had a leg saved by a nice rug.

cheerful.li: I'd love to never need it! But in case I do need it, I'd love to have it! Lots of it!
I've sorted the shelf by color, by size and by how bad the wound has to be! It took no time at all! There's hardly anything on it!

gloomy.li: [night] I dream about running out halfway through surgery. Then I wake up and check the shelf. The dream was more optimistic.
[grieving] I keep thinking about what I could have done with one more dose. I'd like to never think that again.

cold.li: A colonist who dies of infection is a colonist we fed, trained and armed for nothing. Medicine is the cheapest insurance we have.
[trigger:raid] Today's wounded went through most of our stock. The next raid will find us with very little. They always come back.

plain.li: [skill:Medicine] I reorganized the shelf twice, just because I could.

warm.li: I'll sleep tonight. Whatever comes through the door tomorrow, I can do something about it.

blunt.li: Good. Go get shot, if you have to. I'm ready now.

cheerful.li: [promised] Full shelves! You kept your promise and I'm keeping the medicine! Hands off unless you're bleeding!

gloomy.li: Plenty of medicine now. Which means someone's going to need all of it. That's how it works out here.

cold.li: [trigger:raid] Restocked. Our odds for the next raid are back where I want them.

plain.li: [trigger:raid] Next time I'll patch people up with whatever I can find. Moss. Rags. Hope.

warm.li: I'll make do. I always make do. I just wish I weren't making do with people's lives.

blunt.li: [bitter] Fine. When you bleed, don't come to me. Go bleed on the council.

gloomy.li: I'll keep the empty shelf dusted. It's the only thing in the infirmary I can take care of.

cold.li: I'll start triaging by usefulness, then. You may not like where you rank.

plain.li: [repeat] The shelf's still thin. I'm still the one who has to look at it.

blunt.li: [trigger:raid] They'll be back. The medicine won't, unless someone goes and gets some.

cold.li: I've started working out who I'd treat first. I'd prefer to stop.
